items.quote: First big money I’ve made I invested in MBA - it’s 2016 University of Wollongong and 5 sessions a week with a personal trainer
items.statement: The author reports that the first big money they made was invested in an MBA and personal training.

items.quote: even if you do not spend any money on Developing your skills, or body… you pay for that - but more with the Opportunity Cost.
items.statement: The author believes not spending money on developing skills or body incurs an opportunity cost.

items.quote: Instead of “Wanting to Have” - “ I wanted to Become!”
items.statement: The author chose to invest in personal development over luxury items.

items.quote: because I wanted to be on a Safe side I stayed in sharing accommodation till the next April
items.statement: The author stayed in shared accommodation to prioritize funds for personal development.

items.quote: And becoming is a process that never stops!!!
items.statement: The author believes personal development is a continuous process.

overview: Instagram post discussing personal growth and investment decisions.
